Source snapshot `169a34dc320d713ee08acbd3096b03178cf77d00` preserves the 10,077-file candidate with manifest SHA-256 `7b1ffd5da22b9c0cd1807679533cc8b322eeb77e2b5501b96e1e9fcc9fa7ae83`.

This is a draft handoff, with unresolved correctness, constructor closure, integration and performance gates. The prior Linux normal run failed five exact-fallback controls. A coherent custody/deferred-callback repair, its successful-selection correction and an initial constructor accounting slice have independent source-only acceptance; these latest edits have not been formatted, compiled or executed. Online-vacuum inquiry made no new source edits. Its next slice needs caller-wide admission/Close lifetime and checked recoverable-root release decisions first.

All active work is stopped at the user's request. The parent graph will link a durable handoff packet with exact failures, receipts, source identities and next steps. Keep this draft unmerged until the accepted graph gates pass; splitting or rebasing must preserve the same-engine composition and actual capability custody. Ordinary unsupported/finite admission remains closed. No new tests or performance runs were performed to publish this snapshot.
